ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) background with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) localized clusters and linear tracks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity mottle clusters situated at the distal-left margin and the distal-right tip. Discrete linear high-intensity tracks are distributed across the medial and distal sections of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Multi-modal serration profile featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks along the left lobe trailing edge, with higher amplitude jagged irregularities observed near the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature characterized by an increasing gradient towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous non-parallel vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the medial and distal right lobe; sparse oblique linear tracks present on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake mark scars visible across both lobes; significant white focal scarring/pigmentation on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique parallel linear scar grouping located on the upper-medial portion of the right lobe.
